purpose: One publicly branded HTTPS site, path-mounted services and assets, without revealing backend/asset delivery vendor URLs in normal site UI.
coexistence: Additive proposal; does not override networkSpineV1, cloudflareAirTrafficControllerV1, plugin mcp.json, deployed Render config, or currentSourceTruthV3 until review and verified cutover.

proposedSameOriginRoutes.owner: public static HTML application and artist-first entry point
proposedSameOriginRoutes.notes: no privileged admin, no user secrets
preserve streamable HTTP POST/GET as required, streaming headers, host validation, origin authorization; verify ChatGPT MCP client compatibility

proposedSameOriginRoutes.owner: approved and versioned vector, CSS, JS, WebP assets
proposedSameOriginRoutes.cache: long-lived only for rights-approved content-hashed names
proposedSameOriginRoutes.notes: self-hosted path hides backend CDN URL from address bar; do not claim CDN addresses cannot be discovered by inspecting network activity

proposedSameOriginRoutes.cache: html short-lived, hashed assets immutable only when approved
proposedSameOriginRoutes.notes: character motion defaults to lightweight vector; heavy 3D on explicit user action

proposedSameOriginRoutes.owner: optional future signed application update descriptors
proposedSameOriginRoutes.cache: signed artifact immutable by hash, index revalidates

publicVsPrivate: Internal services and resolver names stay under eggiebagelface.lan, never exposed through Cloudflare public DNS; reverse proxy can resolve or use loopback/Unix sockets. Do not expose LAN, DB admin, SSH or local file roots.
proposedPath: ChatGPT plugin -> canonical HTTPS hostname -> Cloudflare public perimeter -> persistent verified origin -> Nginx path-based reverse proxy -> independent bounded backend service

identityAndCerts.cloudflareEdgeCertificate: Cloudflare-managed edge certificate; CA may vary, not assumed Let's Encrypt
identityAndCerts.originTLS: Managed TLS at Render until alternate persistent origin is certified; persistent Ubuntu may use separate origin HTTPS cert
identityAndCerts.ubuntuOriginLetsEncrypt: Certbot DNS-01 via least-privilege Cloudflare DNS token scoped to zone; generate and renew origin key and certificate at origin; never copy edge key from Cloudflare
identityAndCerts.ubuntuOriginPrivateKey: only local approved persistent origin or managed private secret store; never repository, plugin bundle, browser, logs, Codespace Git tree
identityAndCerts.tlsStack: OpenSSL/verified OS trust store serve or validate appropriate local cert chain, not a mechanism to pull private keys from Cloudflare
identityAndCerts.tunnelOrigin: If outbound-only Cloudflare Tunnel used, verify origin name/trust separately and keep noTLSVerify false
identityAndCerts.authTokens: Signed authentication tokens are verified with public keys or trusted authorization metadata. Token signing private key remains in approved private custody. Public TLS key and token-signing key need not be the same.
identityAndCerts.encryptionPolicy: Full strict when proxied to public HTTPS origin with matching valid certificate; path /mcp no caching/challenges after tested compatibility

dnsServices.bind9: Optional only if specifically required to replace/augment private resolver; not reverse proxy, not required for Cloudflare authoritative DNS
dnsServices.reverseProxyCandidate: Nginx available in Ubuntu development image; current networkSpineV1 names apache2, so deliberate canonical owner selection and configuration review required

hosting.codespace: Ubuntu 26.04 userland devcontainer source only; not a guaranteed persistent server or full Ubuntu Server VM
hosting.conflict: Current canonical MCP plan uses dedicated custom mcp subdomain; root /mcp consolidation is proposed, not an automatic redirect or installed plugin migration.

installImpact.sameOriginAssetUpdates: May update behind an already installed compatible shell without host reinstall when provider serves updated resource
installImpact.mcpHostnameChange: An existing ChatGPT plugin connector may require reconfiguration/reconnection if its backend URL changes; not a transparent HTML-only update
installImpact.chatHostCustomUI: Only inside MCP App sandbox, cannot replace ChatGPT native interface

stagedValidation: record existing public site and MCP direct Render health and rollback deployment SHA
choose actual stable origin and source configuration; reconcile Nginx vs Apache policy
validate apex and www DNS, HTTPS SNI and certificate chain; avoid editing current records before approved cutover
validate path routing for /mcp streaming and tool discovery without redirects, caching, WAF challenge or Access interstitial
verify CSS/JS/media same-origin requests only approved /assets/ and no private or user-specific cache
verify signed tokens in private-scope routes only if needed; no conflation with TLS private key
verify connected ChatGPT MCP app renders HTML and correction desk on user device
only after explicit Professor approved cutover update installed plugin URL and deploy, with rollback receipt
rollback: Keep working Render endpoint and previous site deployment intact; use exact prior commit and route receipts if approved migration fails.
